content.text: Fabre explains that the Cabbage White Butterfly lays eggs on many Crucifers, recognizes suitable plants instinctively, and produces two broods annually. Newly hatched caterpillars eat their egg-casings before devouring cabbage, while Microgaster/Apanteles larvae parasitize them internally, feeding on blood and emerging to form cocoons. The narrative then follows Canadian Mounted Police officer Cameron during the 1885 rebellion. Neighbors build his new house, while Smith organizes the work and later rescues Cameron’s family and helps others. Cameron patrols the Sun Dance Trail, investigates Indian conspiracies, cattle raids, and Riel’s rebellion, and eventually captures the Sioux agitator Copperhead. Outlaw Raven saves the cattle herd, dies protecting others, and is recognized as courageous. The rebellion collapses; Cameron’s service is commended, and Dr. Martin remains in the region after declaring his love for Moira.
